title: Cost center pool to paid overage
summary: Enable a cost center AI credit pool and show excess usage rolling into metered budgets when overage is allowed.

steps.title: Use the cost center pool
steps.description: Alice consumes all 3,900 included credits available to the AI Innovation cost center.
steps.expected: The cost center included pool reaches 100%, while paid overage remains $0.

steps.title: Roll into paid overage
steps.description: Alice consumes 2,400 more AI credits after the cost center included pool is exhausted.
steps.expected: $24 of paid overage is attributed to the cost-center and enterprise metered budgets, and the cost-center budget crosses its 75% threshold.
